senses.gloss: वीर्य- + अवदान वीर्य- + अवदान, n. effecting any thing by prowess.
वि-रत- + आशय वि-रत- + आशय (vb. रम्), adj. resigning worldly intentions, Pañc. ii. d. 189.
वीर- + आसन वीर- + आसन, n. 1. a field of [] battle. 2. a bivouac. 3. a kind of posture, Man. 11, 110.
विरूप- + करण विरूप- + करण, n. disfiguring, Rām. 1, 3, 19.
वीर- + देव वीर- + देव, m. a proper name.
विर्य- + धूत वीर्य- + धूत, adj. surpassed in prowess.
वीर- + पट्ट वीर- + पट्ट, m. war [] accoutrement(?), Rājat. 5, 332.
वीर-पान वीर-पान and -पाण, n. the [] drink of warriors, taken for refreshment or to elevate courage.

वि- + रजस् वि- + रजस्,
 I. adj. free from passion, Chr. 16, 17.
 II. f. a woman who has ceased to menstruate.

वि- + रस वि- + रस,
 I. adj. 1. insipid. 2. painful, Utt. Rāmac. 157, 6.
 II. m. pain, Utt. Rāmac. 18, 9.
वि- + राग वि- + राग, m. 1. disinclination, hatred, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1156. 2. the absence of desire or passion, indifference, disregard of all sensual enjoyment, Vedāntas. in Chr. 203, 6.
वि- + रागिन् वि- + रागिन् (properly, विराग + इन्, see रग), adj. void of passion.

वि- + रूप वि- + रूप,
 I. adj. 1. deformed, Pañc. i. d. 159. 2. unusual. 3. wicked, Pañc. 213, 23.
 II. n. 1. difference of nature. 2. deformity, Cāṇ. 73 in Berl. Monatsb. 1864, 411; monstrous shape.
 III. f. पा, the wife of Yama.
वि- + रूपक वि- + रूपक, adj. 1. mis-shaped. 2. frightful, hideous, used as nickname, Daśak. in Chr. 181, 12.
वि- + रेपस् वि- + रेपस्, adj. without blemish, faultless.
वि- + रोष वि- + रोष, adj. angry, Draup. 9, 6.
वीर- + वर वीर- + वर, m. a proper name, Lass. 28, 14.

विरक्ति विरक्ति, i. e. वि-रञ्ज् + ति, and वि-रक्ति, f.
 1. Absence of affection.
 2. Aversion, Pañc. 114, 1.

विरचन वि-रच् + अन, n., and f. ना,
 1. Making, Vikr. d. 153 (read मुक्तावली-विरचना-पुनर्-उक्तम्; cf. वच् and Böhtl. Roth. s. v. पुनरुक्त).
 2. Composing.
 3. Embellishing.
 4. Embellishment, Mālat. 13, 20 (ना).
विरञ्च विरञ्च, and विरञ्चि विरञ्चि (perhaps वि-रच् + अ or इ, but cf. विरिञ्चन), m. Brahman. Śiś. 9, 9; MBh. 1, 1638 has विरिञ्चि.

विरति विरति, i. e. वि-रम् + ति, and वि-रति, f.
 1. Stop.
 2. Cessation.
 3. End, Bhartṛ. 1, 51.
 4. Indifference, Vedāntas. in Chr. 203, 11.
विरप्शिन् विरप्शिन्, adj. Shaking, tossing, Chr. 290, 10 = Rigv. i. 64, 10.
विरम वि-रम् + अ, m. Cessation, sunset, Śiś. 9, 11.

विराम विराम, i. e. वि-रम् + अ, m. []
 1. Cessation, rest, Man. 2, 73; ˚मं या, To rest, Bhartṛ. 2, 72.
 2. End, Utt. Rāmac. 63, 5.
 3. Pause.

विरल विरल (perhaps विल + ल),
 I. adj.
 1. Fine, delicate, thin.
 2. Little, Śiś. 9, 3; few, Rājat. 5, 56.
 3. Loose, relaxed, Utt. Rāmac. 14, 4.
 4. Separated by an interval, wide.
 5. Remote.
 6. Single, Bhartṛ. 2, 33; rare, Prab. 10, 8; Pañc. i. d. 35; ˚लम्, adv. Rarely, Hit. i. d. 32, M.M.
 II. n. Sour curds.
 --Comp.
विरलित विरलित, i. e. विरल + इत, in अ-विरलित-कपोल + म्, adv. With closely united cheeks, Utt. Rāmac. 17, 4.

विरह वि-रह् + अ, m.
 1. Separation, Megh. 12; Rājat. 5, 373; separation from (with instr.), Man. 5, 149.
 2. Absence, Bhāṣāp. 68; want, Hit. 127, 5.
 3. Cessation, Vikr. d. 130.
 4. Relinquishment.
 --Comp.
विरहज विरह-ज, adj. Produced by separation, Vikr. d. 110.

विरहिन् विरहिन्, i. e. विरह + इन्,
 I. adj.
 1. Separate, Mālat. 144, 3.
 2. Absent from
 II. f. इणी.
 1. A woman absent from her husband or lover.
 2. Wages, hire.
विरागार्ह विरागार्ह, i. e. वि-राग-अर्ह (see राग), adj. Fit for freedom from passion, free from passion.

विराज् वि-राज्, m.
 1. Splendour.
 2. A man of the military class.
 3. The name of the first progeny of Brahman, Man. 1, 32; 3, 195.
 4. The consciousness which perceives collections or aggregates, Vedāntas. in Chr. 209, 11.
विराट विराट, m. The name of a country.

विराद्धृ विराद्धृ, i. e. वि-राध् + तृ, m., f. ध्री, and n.
 1. Thwarting, opposing.
 2. Injuring.
 3. Abusive.

विराध वि-राध् + अ, m.
 1. Prevention, opposition.
 2. Vexation.
 3. A Rākṣasa, Utt. Rāmac. 15, 19.
विराधन वि-राध् + अन, n. Pain.
विराव विराव, i. e. वि-रु + अ, m. Sound.

विराविन् विराविन्, i. e. विराव + इन्, adj.
 1. Shouting.
 2. Resounding, Rām. 1, 19, 12.
विरिञ्चन विरिञ्चन, m. Brahman (cf. विरञ्च).
विरिब्ध विरिब्ध (anomal. ptcple. pf. pass. of वि रेभ्), m. A tone, a note.
विरुक्मन्त् विरुक्मन्त्, i. e. वि-रुच् + मन्त्, adj. Splendid, Chr. 291, 3 = Rigv. i. 85, 3 (मतः, acc. pl. f. ved.).

विरुद्धता वि-रुद्ध + ता (vb. रुध्), f.
 1. Opposition, contrariety.
 2. Enmity.
 3. Incongruity, abominableness, Pañc. 260, 3.
 --Comp.
विरूपाक्ष विरूपाक्ष, i. e. वि-रूप-अक्ष, adj. Having deformed eyes; m. Śiva, Johns. Sel. 89, 25.

विरेक विरेक, i. e. वि-रिच् + अ, m., and विरेचन विरेचन, i. e. वि-रिच् + अन, n.
 1. Purging.
 2. A purgative.

विरोक विरोक, i. e. वि-रुच् + अ,
 I. m. A ray of light.
 II. n. A chasm.

विरोचन विरोचन, i. e. वि-रुच् + अन,
 I. m.
 1. Fire.
 2. The sun.
 3. The moon.
 II. (n. ?), Light, lustre, Rājat. 5, 448.

विरोचिष्णु विरोचिष्णु, i. e. वि-रुच् + इष्णु, adj.
 1. Shining.
 2. Illuminating, making visible, Man. 1, 77.

विरोध विरोध, i. e. वि-रुध् + अ,
 I. m.
 1. Hindrance, impediment.
 2. [] Restraint, check.
 3. Opposition, Pañc. 162, 14; Chr. 56, 16; contradiction, Vedāntas. in Chr. 211, 18; Kusumāñj. 3, 8; i. d. 147.
 4. Inconsistency (in argument).
 5. Surrounding.
 6. Siege, blockade.
 7. Enmity, Utt. Rāmac. 146, 1; Pañc. 148, 10.
 8. War.
 9. Calamity.
 II. f. धी, Fixed rule, institute.
 --Comp.

विरोधन विरोधन, i. e. वि-रुध् + अन, n.
 1. Hindering.
 2. Opposition.
 3. Incongruity.
 4. Blockading.
 5. Provoking.
 6. Encountering or defying peril.
 --Comp.

विरोधिन् विरोधिन्, i. e. वि-रुध् and विरोध, + इन्,
 I. adj. f. नी.
 1. Obstructive.
 2. Preventing, impeding, Man. 4, 17.
 3. Contradictory, inconsistent, Vikr. d. 162.
 4. Exclusive, Vedāntas. in Chr. 204, 11.
 5. Besieging, blockading.
 6. Quarrelsome.
 II. m. An enemy, Lass. 2. ed. 88, 28.
 --Comp.
विरोपण विरोपण, i. e. वि-रुह्, Caus., + अन, adj. Healing, Śāk. d. 89.

वीर् वीर्, i. 10 (properly a denomin. derived from वीर), Ātm.
 1. To be valiant.
 2. To show one's heroism.

वीर वीर, i. e. वृ + अ (probably for original वार),
 I. adj.
 1. Heroic.
 2. Strong.
 3. Powerful.
 4. Eminent.
 II. m.
 1. A hero, Chr. 5, 1.
 2. A brave man, Hit. i. d. 169, M.M.
 3. A soldier, Rājat. 5, 134.
 4. Heroism, as a रस or poetical sentiment.
 5. Fire.
 6. Sacrificial fire (see विरहन्, वीरोज्झ, and वीरोपजीविक).
 7. An actor.
 III. f. रा.
 1. A matron, a wife and mother.
 2. The plantain tree.
 3. The name of several plants.
 4. Spirituous liquor, or a particular kind of it.
 IV. n. The name of several plants. वीरतर, see s. v.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Lat. vir; Goth. vair; A.S. wer; probably ἥρως, Ἥρα, Ἡρακλῆς, εἰρήν.

वीरजयन्तिका वीरजयन्तिका, i. e. probably विर-जयन्त + क, f.
 1. A war-dance.
 2. War, battle.

वीरण वीरण,
 I. n. A fragrant grass, Andropogon muricatum, Rām. 2, 80, 8. []
 II. f. णी.
 1. A side-glance.
 2. A deep place.

वीरतर वीर + तर, m.
 1. A distinguished hero, Lass. 48, 11.
 2. An arrow.
वीरता वीर + ता, f. Heroism.

वीरवन्त् वीर + वन्त्,
 I. adj.
 1. Abounding in heroes, Chr. 291, 15 = Rigv. i. 64, 15.
 2. Having a hero.
 II. f. वती, A wife whose husband is living.
वीरहन् वीर-हन्, m. A Brāhmaṇa who has suffered the sacred domestic fire to become extinct.
वीरानक वीरानक, The name of a town, Rājat. 5, 213.
वीराय वीराय, a denomin. derived from वीर with य, To show one's heroism, Utt. Rāmac. 148, 3.
वीरिणी वीरिणी, f. The name of a river, Matsyop. 5.

वीरुध् वीरुध्, i. e. वि-रुह्, f.
 1. A creeper.
 2. A plant which grows again when being cut, Man. 11, 142.
 3. A plant in general, Pañc. iii. d. 50; Vikr. d. 38.
 4. A branch and shoot, Utt. Rāmac. 44, 10.
 --Comp.
वीरोज्झ वीरोज्झ, i. e. वीर-उज्झ् + अ, m. A Brahman who omits offering burnt offerings.
वीरोपजीविक वीरोपजीविक, i. e. वीर-उप-जीव + इक, m. A Brāhmaṇa who claims presents on the merit of having preserved his sacrificial fire.

वीर्य वीर्य, i. e. वीर + य, n.
 1. Strength, power, Chr. 23, 33; Vikr. d. 16.
 2. Fortitude, Chr. 4, 14.
 3. Heroism.
 4. Dignity.
 5. Splendour. []
 --Comp.

वीर्यवन्त् वीर्य + वन्त्, adj.
 1. Strong, Man. 2, 114.
 2. Victorious.
विरह- + व्यापद् विरह- + व्यापद्, adj. (dying), vanishing by separation, Megh. 111.
वीर- + शय्या वीर- + शय्या, f. a certain posture, Lass. 2. ed. 70, 55.
वीर्य- + शालिन् वीर्य- + शालिन्, adj. strong, heroic.
वीर-सेन वीर-सेन, m. the father of Nala, Nal. 1, 1.
वीर- + स्थान वीर- + स्थान, n. a certain posture, Lass. 2. ed. 70, 55.
वीर- + हत्या वीर- + हत्या, f. the slaughter of a man (Jones, ‘a son’), Man. 11, 41.
वीर्य- + हानि वीर्य- + हानि, f. 1. loss of vigour or courage. 2. impotence.
